title: Two-Payment Settlement Schedule of Debt-Age Reductions
content:
# Two-Payment Settlement — Debt-Age Reductions

**Schedule rule.** In pricing a Two-Payment Settlement offer under Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements, the Two-Payment debt age is counted in calendar days from its anchor date up to the offer date. Where the Two-Payment debt age is 1095 days or more, the Two-Payment long-age reduction of 4.0 percentage points applies; where it is at least 730 days but under 1095 days, the Two-Payment mid-age reduction of 2.0 points applies; a Two-Payment debt age under 730 days carries no age reduction.

| Two-Payment debt age on the offer date (calendar days) | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 1095 or more | long-age reduction, 4.0 percentage points |
| 730 to 1094 | mid-age reduction, 2.0 percentage points |
| under 730 | no age reduction |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Debt age | Reduction |
|---|---|
| exactly 1095 days | 4.0 points — the long-age band starts at 1095 |
| 1094 days | 2.0 points |
| exactly 730 days | 2.0 points — the mid-age band starts at 730 |
| 729 days | none |

## Basis Q&A

- **Are the two reductions ever taken together?** No. A debt age falls in exactly one band, and each band carries one figure.
- **To what date is the age counted?** Up to the offer date, in calendar days.
